name: hadd2_bf16_neg
desc: bf16x2 __hadd2(__hneg2(x), y) = (-x)+y. Locks the BF16 branch of the half2 per-lane register-negation fix: the negate lowers to HFMA2.BF16_V2 R0,-RZ.H0_H0,RZ.H0_H0,-R2 (negated accumulator), routed through _get_val_half2(is_bf16=True) -> fneg on <2 x bfloat> (per-lane sign-bit flip). Confirms per-lane neg is correct for bfloat16, not just fp16.
